description:
Extends the profile composer so it writes a coding owner envelope and a complete envelope that holds three owners' sections.

## Background

The offline tuning system calibrates selectors through an owner producer, `crates/<owner>/benches/tuning_calibration.rs`, run by `dev/scripts/tuning-extent-campaign.sh` from a committed campaign declaration: the neutral driver stages and journals the campaign, the composer writes a versioned owner envelope whose measurement block carries the producer's behaviour token and executable digest, and an independent validator accepts the published stage. `gf2-core` and `gf2-algebra` are owners; `gf2-coding` has an owner codec and no producer. The composer `tuning-profile-compose` has an owner mode for each of the two owners and a complete mode that joins their envelopes. Decoder calibration measures the coding owner and imports the committed core and algebra envelopes.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The composer emits a coding owner envelope from a calibrated coding section and verifies it by reopening it through the coding owner codec.
- [hard] REQ-02: Its complete mode writes an envelope holding the core, algebra and coding sections and verifies it by reopening.
- [hard] REQ-03: The composer's existing modes give byte-identical outputs for their existing inputs, and its tests cover the coding owner mode with the three-section complete envelope.
title: Emit a coding owner envelope from the profile composer
